notes: Task-loop evidence: approval/dependency/source readiness is recorded before implementation. Structured builder handoff v2 separates goal, context, constraints and completion references while preserving original task/source values and legacy payloads. Static repairs stop when source and failures repeat instead of spending the remaining budget. Model attempts link to task/stage/repair IDs; context manifests retain file counts, hashes and character sizes without bodies. Repairs record before/after source and candidate outcomes; Diag links later matching-source static, milestone or full behavioral results without claiming causality/current freshness. Test adds six fixed evidence guards and a read-only selected-build audit. Dashboard follows actual readiness/repair events. Unknown usage, older unattributed attempts and missing run boundaries remain explicit. Approved plans, frozen checks, execution/cloud consent and bounded calls are preserved. No new provider, dependency, automatic routing promotion or live model-quality claim.
